post.originalText:
🚨 GEMINI 4 PRO IS GOING HEAD-TO-HEAD WITH OPUS 5.

I gave both models the exact same prompt:

“Create a 3D dragon using Three.js. Use a white background so the main object stays visible.”

Opus 5 was running at Max effort.

Gemini 4 Pro still managed to keep up.

And that’s the interesting part.

This isn’t a benchmark score. It’s the actual output side by side, built from the same prompt.

Gemini 4 Pro is starting to look seriously competitive for complex visual coding.

Which one would you pick?
